source: Central Valley Regional Water Quality Control Board (Region 5), PRA #633 production posted to the Water Board FTP 2026-10-07 (downloaded 2026-10-21; agency confirmed complete 2026-10-26). Raw files held off-repo; sha256 in data/incoming/2026-10/cvrwqcb-r5/MANIFEST.md; per-file inventory in ftp_inventory.csv.
finding: None of the 94 files contains a pesticide or herbicide result, application record, pounds or acres, apart from the CEDEN export (already on the site: Benner Creek 2022 and two paraquat non-detects in 2021). The WDR files are small-wastewater-plant monitoring reports; the two NPS lab reports are metals tests.
confidence: HIGH for contents (read from the Board's own files); MEDIUM for facility points (PLSS section centroids from the Board's Notice of Applicability legal description, not surveyed plant locations)

facilities.name: Plumas Eureka Community Services District wastewater treatment plants #6 and #7
facilities.related: Separate record: Plumas Eureka CSD's drinking-water system is where the county's only glyphosate tests were run (14, all below the reporting level; Public water systems layer).
facilities.order: General Order 2014-0153-DWQ-R5332 (small domestic wastewater systems); previously WDRs Order 98-007
facilities.discharge: Treated domestic wastewater to leachfields (community leachfield 'Dynamite Hill' plus two backup leachfields); drainage to the Feather River
facilities.geom_note: Mean of the BLM CadNSDI centroids of Sections 4, 5, 8 and 9, T22N R12E MDB&M, the sections the Board's 2020 Notice of Applicability names for the plants and leachfields (the notice prints the range as 'R12W'; Plumas County lies east of the Mount Diablo meridian, so R12E). Approximate to about half a mile.

facilities.name: Whitehawk Ranch Mutual Water Company wastewater treatment and disposal system
facilities.order: General Order 2014-0153-DWQ-R5194 (small domestic wastewater systems, notice of 2015-12-09); previously WDRs Order 92-127
facilities.discharge: Treated domestic wastewater to subsurface disposal and a land-application area; surface-water checks on Sulphur Creek up- and downstream
facilities.geom_note: BLM CadNSDI centroid of Section 31, T22N R13E MDB&M, the section the Board's 2015 Notice of Applicability names. Approximate to about half a mile.
